snippet.title: 【New Prototype Preview】Dancing Gracefully Through the Lightning and Wind – Rachel
snippet.description:
The brand-new Prototype Rachel will be available on July 25(UTC+8), 2024, in the DLC BlazBlue Entropy Effect - Rachel Character Pack!

This DLC includes a new Prototype: Rachel, a set of Prototype Palettes applicable to all characters (including future IP characters), and a new exclusive Avatar trail effect.

The DLC is priced at $4.99 USD, with a launch discount of 25% off for the first week!
Players who purchased the base game BlazBlue Entropy Effect early will automatically receive this DLC for free—no extra purchase needed!

Steam Store Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/22...
